articles.title: Future of healthcare: Extinction or accelerated evolution?
articles.summary: Shapers of healthcare’s future must evolve under relentless economic pressure. To avoid extinction, they must harness AI and biopharma breakthroughs to innovate clinical and business models.

articles.title: How CFOs can make AI pay off
articles.summary: Creating value from AI in finance—and beyond—requires setting measurable targets and redesigning processes. Here’s how.

articles.title: Could aviation at last be close to earning its wings?
articles.summary: The aviation value chain’s recent performance tells divergent stories: More airlines are creating value, and more are doing so consistently—yet the industry still cannot cover its cost of capital.

articles.title: How AI is transforming automotive quality operations
articles.summary: Yoav Levy, cofounder and CEO of Upstream, explains how AI can reduce warranty and recall costs through early issue detection, accelerated investigations, and targeted countermeasures.

articles.title: Suomen suuryritysten kasvumahdollisuus: välikatsaus
articles.summary: Vuosi sitten tutkimuksemme osoitti, että Suomen suurimmat listatut yhtiöt ovat kasvaneet selvästi hitaammin kuin globaalit verrokit. Näemme jo myönteistä kehitystä – seuraavaksi kasvua on aika vauhdittaa suurilla liikkeillä.
